correctness.rationale: Exact finite spline pairing reduces all Zak zeros to a simple cubic root problem. The cubic discriminant is negative by a manifestly positive Bernstein polynomial on the entire parameter interval, forcing one simple real cubic root. Signs at y=0 and y=1/4 yield exact complete zero counts; analytic factorization proves multiplicities. Two exact rescalings and the implicit-function theorem prove exponents 1/2 and 2/3. Critical identities verified with package check.py and direct finite-sum comparisons.
